description: Baseline periodic 3D GW parameter prescription. Values mirror the LibRPA BN regression family.

nfreq.per_system_override_rule: Raise for a denser imaginary-frequency grid when the heavy-element tail is slow; the fast benchmark uses 6-8.
nfreq.rationale: Frequency grid density controls the accuracy of the screened interaction; small fast cases converge with nfreq 6-8 while production uses ~24.

nbands.per_system_override_rule: Set nbands equal to the physical basis dimension (nbasis); never truncate the state space.
nbands.rationale: An incomplete state space corrupts EXX/GW. nbands is system-dependent so it is never pinned by a prescription.

screening_kgrid.per_system_override_rule: Use the SCF mesh; keep it regular and Gamma-centred for the screening sum.
screening_kgrid.rationale: The screening k-mesh must match the ABACUS producer mesh so the Coulomb and bz_sampling definitions agree.

basis_family.per_system_override_rule: Use a PP/basis pair that was generated together; mismatched PP and NAO corrupts EXX.
basis_family.rationale: PseudoDojo NC-SR with a matched TZDP orbital set is the validated default; PP/orbital mismatch is a known garbage-EXX cause.

nao_family.per_system_override_rule: Prefer a triple-zeta-plus-polarisation NAO family for GW; a double-zeta set underdescribes the empty states.
nao_family.rationale: GW needs a flexible empty-state manifold; TZDP is the validated family for the regression set.

abfs_family.per_system_override_rule: Generate ABFS on the remote host for the exact STRU; never reuse an ABFS set from another cell.
abfs_family.rationale: The auxiliary basis must be generated for the actual structure; a stale ABFS silently changes the Coulomb metric.

shrink_threshold.per_system_override_rule: Tighten the shrink threshold when the ABFS set is nearly linearly dependent for a heavy-element system.
shrink_threshold.rationale: shrink_lu_inv_thr controls the LU inversion cutoff for the shrunk auxiliary basis; too loose a value corrupts the Coulomb metric.

exx_cs_inv_thr.per_system_override_rule: Default to the explicit safe threshold 1e-5 for an UNKNOWN system, because the automatic (-1.0) cutoff is what breaks heavy elements. Known light-element families may relax it back to -1.0 (automatic); heavy-element families tighten the allowed range to 1e-6..1e-4.
exx_cs_inv_thr.rationale: The automatic Cs-inverse cutoff is too aggressive for heavy elements and produces completely wrong EXX bands, so an unclassified system gets the safe explicit threshold by default rather than the automatic value.
